messages:
Alex: Quick heads-up — planning a soft launch of the new `Config Visibility` panel in Console tomorrow morning. Need a short ops + telemetry checklist before we flip the beta flag.
Priya: What exactly will the panel show? sensitive info concerns?
Alex: It surfaces recent runtime-config changes (last actor, diff + old vs new, comment if present). Nothing that pulls secret values — we redact values by default. Also exposes a per-route impact preview (estimated % of traffic affected).
Sam: +1 on redaction. Also please ensure any KMS/HSM-backed secrets stay masked. We should fail closed if detection fails.
Marta: For telemetry, what gates are we using? latency, error rate, config-apply failures?
Alex: Proposed gates: P95 UI latency delta < 50ms, frontend error-rate delta < 0.5%, backend config-apply failure > 0.1% -> auto-rollback. Also we collect adoption signals: click-through on diffs and exports.
Jae: Can we do shadow mode first? show nothing in prod UI but collect metrics and logs for a week. That helps tune thresholds.
Alex: Yes. Rollout plan I'm thinking: (1) shadow for 7 days across all orgs, (2) enable UI for 5% of orgs (canary), (3) expand to 25% after 48h if gates OK, (4) GA to all. Dry-run command for infra: `./scripts/launch-config-visibility --env=prod --dry-run`.
ops-bot: Deploy scheduled: config-visibility service will enter shadow mode at 2023-11-01T09:00 UTC (ticket RW-8472).
Priya: Retention for the audit entries? legal asked earlier about 90 days by default. Can we make it tenant-configurable?
Alex: Default 90d, admin setting to extend to 2y for enterprise customers (opt-in). We'll add a console hint about retention.
Sam: Permission model? Who can view diffs? Suggest a new role `view-config-changes` (granted to org-admins and above).
Alex: Agree. We'll implement RBAC check and hide the panel if no permission. Also a feature flag toggle: `console.config_visibility_beta` to control rollout.
Marta: For the telemetry pipeline, please include the following tags: `org_id`, `route`, `actor_role`, `diff_size`. We need those for slicing.
Jae: Also sample the heavy diffs (large JSON blobs) at 1% to avoid pipeline pressure, but keep counts for trend signals.
Alex: Good call. We'll sample diffs > 10KB at 1% and keep counters. Telemetry alert rules: create a Prometheus alert `ConfigVisibility_UI_P95_Increase` -> threshold 50ms for 15m, and `ConfigApply_Failure_Rate` -> 0.1% over 10m.
Sam: One more: ensure console routes that render diffs use streaming + incremental rendering so large diffs don't spike page TTFB.
Alex: Noted. Sam, can your team add an incremental renderer? maybe use chunked rendering with a fallback.
Sam: Yep, will prototype today.
Priya: Anything needed from security/compliance before canary? I'll ping them but want a checklist.
Alex: Checklist: (a) secrets redaction verified (sec), (b) RBAC enforced (iam), (c) retention SLA doc (legal), (d) telemetry privacy signoff. I'll open a PR with details.
Jae: Suggest we add an opt-out switch per-org for the shadow data collection to be safe for sensitive customers.
Alex: We'll add `org.config_visibility_collect=false` default true with an override. Ops: reserve canary capacity?
ops-bot: Canary capacity request sent to infra-pool. Reply from infra expected within 2 hours.
Priya: :thumbsup: if we can keep the UI minimal at first (no exports), + remind folks not to add CSV export until legal signs off.
Alex: Agreed — exports disabled in canary. I'll open the rollout ticket and add the telemetry gating dashboard links. If no objections by EOD we'll proceed with the shadow launch tomorrow.
Sam: No objections from my side. small ask: add a quick rollback runbook snippet in the ticket: `feature flag off -> purge session cache -> revert canary`.
Alex: Will do. Thanks all — I'll post the ticket link once created.
Priya: Thanks.
Marta: Thanks, team.
Jae: LGTM.
ops-bot: Note: rolling shadow start will emit initial synthetic events to validate pipeline within first 10m.
